runs.narr: TOO HARD (WORK) at Q2 after Q1 IN (Amentum Holdings; NYSE AMTM; engineering and technology services to U.S. and allied governments, formed 2024 from Legacy Amentum and Jacobs's Critical Mission Solutions). The deciding part, Global Engineering Solutions at 66% of segment Adjusted EBITDA, sets no price of its own and is re-bid at every recompete; the filer's own revenue bridges over FY2021 to FY2025 show the rebuilding neither failing nor holding, and its ten-year margins sit below Booz Allen's, CACI's and KBR's every year. Computation beneath the stop: value $23.07 to $28.79 all-equity at 5.43% against $19.52, no case earns the floor (best 6.88%, FY2025 alone 9.17%), fair $7.45 ($12.89 equity-only), not armed; research pass written and closed unrun. Facts recorded, not judged: goodwill above equity at every year-end, two predecessor goodwill impairments, receivables factoring, NASA work moving in-house, pay on Adjusted EBITDA with targets adjusted. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: no measure of a rebuilt moat failing, a non-GAAP segment measure sizing parts, a reverse acquisition and an unfiled predecessor year, a predecessor's purchases under the serial-acquirer rule, factoring, the add-back tax rate, a price below the range that fails the floor.
